authorization_provenance.confirmed_by_human_user_via_parent: qPCR每组6只独立大鼠，每只各测一次；靶基因与β-actin同列Ct属于同一只大鼠。WB每组3只。

methods.animal_delta_ct: target Ct - β-actin Ct from the same animal/column
methods.assumed_amplification_efficiency: 100% for each target and reference (E=2); unverified assumption
methods.calibrator: arithmetic mean Q in the six sham animals, calculated separately for each gene
methods.animal_fold: animal Q / arithmetic mean Q of sham group; sham-group arithmetic mean fold equals 1
methods.descriptive_reporting: animal fold arithmetic mean ± sample SD (ddof=1), n=6 biological animals per group
methods.primary_tests: independent-group, two-sided Welch t tests for model vs sham, reset vs sham, and reset vs model, separately for each of six genes
methods.multiplicity: single Holm step-down family across all 18 primary pairwise tests; alpha=0.05
methods.confidence_intervals: two-sided 95% Welch intervals for ΔCt mean differences, unadjusted for multiplicity; expression ratio intervals obtained by monotone transformation 2^(-ΔCt difference)
methods.effect_size_definition: 2^(-difference of group mean ΔCt) is a geometric expression ratio; also report ratio of arithmetic mean Q/fold. These two summaries need not be identical.
methods.diagnostics: Shapiro-Wilk within each group/endpoint and median-centered Levene per endpoint, diagnostic only; not used to switch tests mechanically. n=6 gives limited normality-diagnostic power.
methods.secondary_test: gene-wise Welch ANOVA on ΔCt, presented as unadjusted secondary diagnostics; not pooled across genes.

software.verification: Welch t, df, P and CI independently computed from sample means/variances and cross-checked against scipy.stats.ttest_ind; Welch ANOVA manual formula cross-checked against scipy.stats.f_oneway(equal_var=False).

limitations: The 100% equal-efficiency assumption requires experimental confirmation; a shared efficiency does not substitute for measured amplification-efficiency and assay-specificity validation.

Amplification/melting curves, no-template/no-RT controls, and assay detection/quantification limits are unavailable in supplied files. High Ct values for NOX4/AT1-R warrant review of raw curves and assay qualification; no values excluded.
β-actin is the only reference gene. Lack of a significant between-group β-actin Ct difference would not establish reference-gene stability or justify unverified normalization assumptions.
PCR report does not list RhoA/ROCK1/ROCK2 primers although the XLS contains those results. Their assay identities remain to be documented.
SCG group lacks original Ct data and is excluded from reanalysis.
The user supplied the biological-repeat and matching confirmation; original XLS does not itself contain specimen identifiers. Source columns are retained for traceability.
Each animal has one recorded qPCR measurement; technical repeat precision cannot be assessed from this workbook.
The 95% effect intervals are nominal, not simultaneous family-wise intervals; statistical significance is judged by the 18-test Holm-adjusted P values.
Results are an exploratory retrospective reanalysis of supplied data; they do not establish causal activation/inhibition of a pathway or mediation by the sympathetic nervous system.

multiplicity_summary.adjustment_formula: For sorted p_(j), adjusted p_(j)=min(1,max_{k<=j}((18-k+1)*p_(k))); restore original order.
